note: Both sets struggle significantly with the dual-axis graph, frequently confusing the Gain-Correction Factor (left axis) with Proportional/Integral Gains (right axis), resulting in similar hallucinated values (e.g., 0.8 s, 0.32). However, Set B is preferred because it correctly extracts the gain-correction formula (Eq. 7-20) which Set A misses entirely, and Set B is slightly less repetitive with the text-based gain values (fewer trivial duplicates).
